maintenance_led.reason: Revenue is tuition from students enrolling in University of Phoenix degree programs, not repair, servicing or replacement of installed products.

publicly_funded.reason: University of Phoenix tuition is mostly paid through federal Title IV student aid and military or veteran education benefits.

serial_acquirer.reason: Growth comes from enrolling more students in University of Phoenix online degree programs, not from regular acquisitions.

mission_critical.reason: Students can move to other online universities. Switching is inconvenient but isn't operationally critical, unlike core software or regulated services.

notes: The federal funding share comes from my own knowledge, not the website text.
